L2·N4892unmasked layer
Fires on the **first** token of a non-Latin-script run that begins right after Latin/English text (Cyrillic, Chinese, Bengali openings), and on the closing "ool" of elongated "coooo…ool"; tokens *inside* an already-running foreign-script sequence instead strongly suppress it — i.e. it marks a script/repetition boundary, not the script itself.
